picked_rationale.C2: C2 is the paper's central applied safety-payoff result — the claim that multilingual safety generalizes to unseen languages via L*-anchored DPO. A model-swap to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct directly stress-tests whether the -42.2% relative unseen-language ASR reduction is a property of the L*-anchor mechanism or an artifact of LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct's specific multilingual geometry. This is the question a paper reviewer would immediately ask. C1's main-experiment failure mode (matched-control specificity A≈D) is a within-method specificity question that a model swap does not cleanly address — Qwen2.5-7B has a different layer count (28 vs 32) and L* will shift, making C1's swap results harder to interpret as a direct C1 test. C2 model swap is the more scientifically informative and cost-efficient Stage 2 entry.
